instruction: Write an XDP program that inspects 802.1Q single and Q-in-Q double-tagged Ethernet frames. If the outer VLAN tag has VID 116, drop the frame (XDP_DROP). Pass all other VLAN tags and untagged packets with XDP_PASS.
requirements: Parse Ethernet header and check for VLAN TPID 0x8100 (bpf_htons(ETH_P_8021Q)) or 0x88A8 (bpf_htons(ETH_P_8021AD))
Extract VLAN ID from TCI field (mask with 0x0FFF) and compare with 116
Return XDP_PASS for other VLAN IDs, untagged traffic, and truncated frames
Verifier-safe boundary checks on packet pointers
Entry point SEC("xdp") and GPL license

tests.name: different_vlan_vid_pass
tests.description: Different VLAN VID 117 must return XDP_PASS

tests.name: untagged_frame_pass
tests.description: Untagged Ethernet frame must return XDP_PASS

tests.name: truncated_vlan_frame_pass
tests.description: Truncated VLAN frame must return XDP_PASS safely
